+++ 
@@ -1,9 +1,117 @@
-import { Text, View } from "react-native";
+import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
+import { SafeAreaView, StyleSheet, Text, View } from "react-native";
 
+type Item = { codigo: string; qtd: number; hora: string };
+
 export default function Contagem() {
+  // futuro: quando ligarmos ao leitor/entrada manual, vamos preencher isso
+  const [itens, setItens] = useState<Item[]>([]);
+
+  const produtosDiferentes = useMemo(
+    () => new Set(itens.map(i => i.codigo)).size,
+    [itens]
+  );
+  const quantidadeTotal = useMemo(
+    () => itens.reduce((s, i) => s + i.qtd, 0),
+    [itens]
+  );
+  const ultimoProduto = useMemo(
+    () => (itens.length ? itens[0].codigo : "—"),
+    [itens]
+  );
+
   return (
-    <View style={{ flex: 1, alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }}>
-      <Text style={{ fontSize: 20, fontWeight: "600" }}>Contagem</Text>
+    <SafeAreaView style={s.container}>
+      {/* Cabeçalho */}
+      <View style={s.header}>
+        <Text style={s.headerTitle}>LobosTi Contagem</Text>
+      </View>
+
+      {/* KPIs */}
+      <View style={s.kpisRow}>
+        <KpiCard
+          label="Produtos"
+          hint="(diferentes)"
+          value={String(produtosDiferentes)}
+        />
+        <KpiCard
+          label="Quantidade Total"
+          value={String(quantidadeTotal)}
+        />
+        <KpiCard
+          label="Último Produto"
+          value={String(ultimoProduto)}
+          mono
+        />
+      </View>
+
+      {/* Lista (vazia por enquanto) */}
+      <View style={s.listEmpty}>
+        <Text style={s.emptyTitle}>Nenhum item contado ainda</Text>
+        <Text style={s.emptyHint}>A lista aparecerá aqui.</Text>
+      </View>
+    </SafeAreaView>
+  );
+}
+
+function KpiCard({
+  label,
+  value,
+  hint,
+  mono,
+}: {
+  label: string;
+  value: string | number;
+  hint?: string;
+  mono?: boolean;
+}) {
+  return (
+    <View style={s.kpiCard}>
+      <Text style={s.kpiLabel}>
+        {label} {hint ? <Text style={s.kpiHint}>{hint}</Text> : null}
+      </Text>
+      <Text style={[s.kpiValue, mono && s.kpiMono]} numberOfLines={1}>
+        {value}
+      </Text>
     </View>
   );
 }
+
+const s = StyleSheet.create({
+  container: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: "#fff" },
+  header: {
+    paddingHorizontal: 16,
+    paddingVertical: 14,
+    borderBottomWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
+    borderColor: "#ddd",
+  },
+  headerTitle: { fontSize: 18, fontWeight: "700" },
+
+  kpisRow: {
+    flexDirection: "row",
+    gap: 10,
+    paddingHorizontal: 12,
+    paddingVertical: 12,
+  },
+  kpiCard: {
+    flex: 1,
+    padding: 12,
+    borderRadius: 12,
+    backgroundColor: "#f4f4f4",
+  },
+  kpiLabel: { fontSize: 12, color: "#444", marginBottom: 6 },
+  kpiHint: { color: "#777", fontSize: 12 },
+  kpiValue: { fontSize: 20, fontWeight: "800" },
+  kpiMono: { fontFamily: Platform.select({ default: "monospace" }) },
+
+  listEmpty: {
+    flex: 1,
+    borderTopWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
+    borderColor: "#eee",
+    alignItems: "center",
+    justifyContent: "center",
+    gap: 6,
+  },
+  emptyTitle: { fontSize: 16, fontWeight: "600" },
+  emptyHint: { fontSize: 12, color: "#666" },
+});
